title: Procurement of Geyser, Refrigerator, Air Conditioner and Washing Machine for Different Lighthouses Under Kolkata Directorate.
summary: Supply and installation of geysers, refrigerators, air conditioners and washing machines for various lighthouses under the Kolkata Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR from any commercial bank; exemption for valid MSME/NSIC registration. Original EMD/MSME/NSIC certificate to reach office on or before technical bid opening. Tender fee not applicable.

eligibility: Reputed firms with experience in supply & installation of geyser, refrigerator, air conditioner and washing machine in Central Govt/State Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies
notes: Document is only the NIT section (pages numbered 3-5); no quantities, lighthouse list or specifications included. Bid submission 03.09.2026 17:00 to 14.09.2026 15:00; technical bid opening 15.09.2026 16:00.
